title: 第22课 · 你看过京剧吗
subtitle: Lesson 22 — 你看过京剧吗 · Have you seen Beijing Opera

items.en: experiential aspect marker (ever)

items.py: jīngjù
items.en: Beijing Opera

items.py: biǎoyǎn
items.en: performance; to perform

items.py: Chángchéng
items.en: the Great Wall

items.py: Běijīng kǎoyā
items.en: Peking roast duck

items.py: tīng shuō
items.en: to hear (that); it is said

items.py: yǒumíng
items.en: famous

items.en: always; never (with 没)

items.py: fànguǎnr
items.en: restaurant

items.en: theatre

items.py: Nǐ kàn guo jīngjù ma?
items.en: Have you ever seen Beijing Opera?

items.py: Wǒ kàn guo yī cì.
items.en: I've seen it once.

items.py: Wǒ méi qù guo Chángchéng.
items.en: I've never been to the Great Wall.

items.py: Nǐ chī guo Běijīng kǎoyā ma?
items.en: Have you ever had Peking duck?

items.py: Nǐ tīng guo Zhōngguó yīnyuè ma?
items.en: Have you ever listened to Chinese music?

items.py: Wǒ cónglái méi kàn guo.
items.en: I've never seen it.

items.zh: 刘京：大卫，你看过京剧吗？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Dàwèi, nǐ kàn guo jīngjù ma?
items.en: Liu Jing: David, have you ever seen Beijing Opera?

items.zh: 大卫：没看过。听说很有意思。
items.py: Dàwèi: Méi kàn guo. Tīng shuō hěn yǒu yìsi.
items.en: David: No. I've heard it's very interesting.

items.zh: 刘京：今天晚上有京剧表演，我们一起去看吧。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Jīntiān wǎnshang yǒu jīngjù biǎoyǎn, wǒmen yīqǐ qù kàn ba.
items.en: Liu Jing: There's a performance tonight, let's go watch.

items.py: Dàwèi: Tài hǎo le! Zài nǎr?
items.en: David: Great! Where?

items.zh: 刘京：在长安大戏院。你去过那儿吗？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Zài Cháng'ān Dà Xìyuàn. Nǐ qù guo nàr ma?
items.en: Liu Jing: At Chang'an Grand Theatre. Have you been there?

items.zh: 大卫：没去过。离这儿远吗？
items.py: Dàwèi: Méi qù guo. Lí zhèr yuǎn ma?
items.en: David: No. Is it far from here?

items.zh: 刘京：不远。我们坐地铁去吧。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Bù yuǎn. Wǒmen zuò dìtiě qù ba.
items.en: Liu Jing: Not far. Let's take the subway.

items.zh: 玛丽：和子，你吃过北京烤鸭吗？
items.py: Mǎlì: Hézǐ, nǐ chī guo Běijīng kǎoyā ma?
items.en: Mary: Hezi, have you ever had Peking duck?

items.zh: 和子：吃过。非常好吃。你呢？
items.py: Hézǐ: Chī guo. Fēicháng hǎo chī. Nǐ ne?
items.en: Hezi: Yes. It's delicious. You?

items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ hái méi chī guo ne.
items.en: Mary: I haven't had it yet.

items.zh: 和子：那我们去全聚德吃吧！
items.py: Hézǐ: Nà wǒmen qù Quánjùdé chī ba!
items.en: Hezi: Let's go to Quanjude then!

items.zh: 玛丽：全聚德？我听说过那个饭馆儿。
items.py: Mǎlì: Quánjùdé? Wǒ tīng shuō guo nàge fànguǎnr.
items.en: Mary: Quanjude? I've heard of that restaurant.

items.zh: 和子：是的，很有名。你去过长城吗？
items.py: Hézǐ: Shì de, hěn yǒumíng. Nǐ qù guo Chángchéng ma?
items.en: Hezi: Yes, it's famous. Have you been to the Great Wall?

items.py: Mǎlì: Qù guo liǎng cì le.
items.en: Mary: I've been twice.

items.py: Wǒ qù guo Zhōngguó.
items.en: I've been to China. (过 = at some time in the past)

items.py: Wǒ méi qù guo Rìběn.
items.en: I've never been to Japan. (没 + V + 过)

items.zh: 你看过这个电影吗？——看过。
items.py: Nǐ kàn guo zhège diànyǐng ma? —— Kàn guo.
items.en: Have you seen this movie? — Yes.

items.py: Tā cónglái méi hē guo báijiǔ.
items.en: He has never drunk baijiu. (从来没...过)

items.py: Nǐ lái guo jǐ cì? —— Lái guo sān cì.
items.en: How many times have you been here? — Three times.

items.py: Nǐ qù guo Chángchéng ma? —— Qù guo.
items.en: Have you been to the Great Wall? — Yes.

items.py: Nǐ qù guo Gùgōng ma? —— Méi qù guo.
items.en: Have you been to the Forbidden City? — No.

items.py: Nǐ qù guo Yíhéyuán ma?
items.en: Have you been to the Summer Palace?

items.py: Nǐ qù guo Tiāntán ma?
items.en: Have you been to the Temple of Heaven?

items.py: Nǐ chī guo jiǎozi ma? —— Chī guo.
items.en: Have you eaten dumplings? — Yes.

items.py: Nǐ xué guo tàijíquán ma?
items.en: Have you studied tai chi?

items.zh: 你看过中国功夫电影吗？
items.py: Nǐ kàn guo Zhōngguó gōngfu diànyǐng ma?
items.en: Have you seen Chinese kung fu movies?
